question: Which sages are included in the continuing enumeration of named items?
premises: The verse lists kaśyapaṃ as a named item.
The verse lists bharadvājaṃ as a named item.
The verse lists viśvāmitraṃ and gautamam as named items.
inference: Kaśyapa, Bharadvāja, Viśvāmitra, and Gautama are included in this part of the enumeration.
uncertainties: The syntactic role of these names relative to the previously listed weapons is not fully specified within this verse alone.
